top_signals.title: Core CPI rose a faster-than-forecast 0.3% in August, setting up possible Fed rate hike
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in August, as expected; core inflation was higher than estimated
top_signals.summary: The all-items consumer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, with core, excluding food and energy, showing a 0.2% gain, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: Tennis player Taylor Fritz has accused US Open supplier Wilson of misleading players over the quality of their replica balls.
